item.text: The provider currently tries to create a vault during initialization, and it reads aliases immediately after that call. That couples drawer rendering to vault creation. I’ll move vault creation to the alias options flow and keep initial loading read only.

item.text: The bridge contract currently requires a callback and creates a vault as a side effect. I’ll split that into `getDefault` and `createDefaultVault`, then update the provider so an account with no vault reaches the empty state without making an alias fetch.

item.text:
Fixed the PassAliases drawer. It now shows the alias list when aliases exist, shows “No aliases” when they do not, and opens the creation modal from “Get an alias.” Vault creation happens when the user starts that flow; saving an alias refreshes the list and its cache.

The bridge and provider contracts are updated. Validation passed: 11 focused tests, both package type checks, lint, formatting, and `git diff --check`.
